name: Esp32 Camera → On Capture End
description: Runs after the image was captured, also when a stream cancels the capture and on shutdown. If no frame that started after the delay arrived 4 seconds after **on_capture_start**, it runs as well and the next frame is used as is. The 4 seconds include **capture_delay**, so with `3s` about one second is left. A `light` may stay on after shutdown, an `output` does not.
